value.rationale: Separates almost-sure and second-moment convergence from fourth-moment reliability on perfectly conditioned linear systems. The threshold is sharp, not chosen arbitrarily; it quantifies the rare-small-entry amplification mechanism, and row Kaczmarz on the identical data has a decaying fourth moment. This supplies a motivated stress test for entrywise numerical linear solvers rather than a trivial rescaling.
